message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules**

| Section | What you need to know |
|---------|-----------------------|
| **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or whatever house rule you set). Points are earned by being the first to empty your hand in each round. |
| **Players** | 2–10 (standard deck works best with 4–8). |
| **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue) × 25 cards each (one 0, two 1–9, two “Draw Two”, two “Skip”, two “Reverse”), plus 4 “Wild” and 4 “Wild Draw Four”. |
| **Setup** | 1. Shuffle the deck. 2. Deal 7 cards to each player. 3. Place the remaining cards face‑down as the draw pile. 4. Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. If it’s a special card, apply its effect immediately (e.g., if it’s a “Draw Two”, the first player draws two cards and loses a turn). |

---

### 1. Turn Order

- Players sit around the table.  
- Play proceeds clockwise (unless a “Reverse” card changes direction).  
- On your turn you may **play one card** or **draw one card**.

---

### 2. Playing a Card

| Card | How to play | Effect |
|------|-------------|--------|
| **Number (0‑9)** | Match color or number of the top discard. | None. |
| **Draw Two** | Match color. | Next player draws two cards and skips their turn. |
| **Skip** | Match color. | Next player loses their turn. |
| **Reverse** | Match color. | Reverses play direction. |
| **Wild** | Any color. | You choose the new active color. |
| **Wild Draw Four** | Any color. | You choose the new active color; next player draws four cards and skips their turn. **(Can only be played if you have no matching color cards; otherwise you risk a challenge.)** |

**Rule of “Uno”** – When you have only one card left, you must shout “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. Failure to do so results in a penalty (usually drawing two cards).

---

### 3. Drawing Cards

- If you cannot play any card, you must draw one card from the draw pile.  
- If that card can be played, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends.  
- If the draw pile runs out, shuffle the discard pile (except the top card) to form a new draw pile.

---

### 4. Winning a Round

- The first player to discard all their cards wins the round.  
- Score points:  
  - Number cards: face value.  
  - Draw Two, Skip, Reverse: 20 points each.  
  - Wild, Wild Draw Four: 50 points each.  
- Add the winner’s score to their total.  
- If the winner reaches 500 points (or your chosen target), the game ends. Otherwise, start a new round with the same deck.

---

### 5. Common Variations & House Rules

| Variation | What it changes |
|-----------|-----------------|
| **“Stacking”** | Players can stack Draw Two or Wild Draw Four cards to avoid drawing. |
| **“Seven-O”** | 7 lets you swap hands; 0 forces the next player to draw a card. |
| **“Jump-In”** | If you have an exact match to the top card, you can play immediately, even out of turn. |
| **“Custom Decks”** | Use themed decks (e.g., Uno Attack) with additional mechanics. |

---

### 6. Quick Tips

- Keep an eye on opponents’ colors; if you see someone running low on a particular color, consider playing a Wild to change the color away from them.  
- Save your Wild Draw Four for when you’re sure you have no matching color cards—otherwise you risk a challenge.  
- Remember to shout “UNO!”—it’s a fun part of the game and a good way to keep everyone honest.

Enjoy your game!
